cay_historian.text: Pedro St. James was built around 1780, from limestone and hard wood. It's the oldest stone building left on the islands.
In 1831 the islanders held a meeting here and set up the first elected local assembly. A small group of men in a big room, deciding things. That's democracy for you: a few chairs and a lot of tea.

cay_housekeeper.text: The kitchen was out in the yard because of the heat and fire. The great house is for show; the kitchen is for dinner.
Mind the floor, it's older than the building.
